process_conclusion: The audit found a concrete advantage for explicit highest-value selection at the selection-principle level: the prior opportunistic pattern chose objectives from receipt/queue follow-ons (activation 37257258857 closed a pending receipt item; activation 37260572520 recorded its process delta as UNVERIFIED specifically because its objective came from a queued receipt item rather than a frontier cell), whereas seven consecutive frontier-first activations each closed a distinct cell with a decisive verdict, independent verification, and no equivalent re-test. The controller selector faithfully implements the same principle via ordinal qualitative ranking plus anti-repeat status transitions. No selector change was made because no bottleneck or capability loss was observed; the residual uncertainty is that the controller's end-to-end causal effect is not yet isolated.
research_conclusion: COST-ROBUSTNESS UNVERIFIED (conditional classification). Predeclared grid {0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0}x the existing realistic cost model (commission_per_trade=2.0, commission_per_share=0.003, slippage_cents=2.0, slippage_proportional=0.0005), lookbacks 3/5/10, 10-asset collected universe, walk-forward 252/84/60/60, 4 volatility blocks, matched coin-flip null. Classification (edge(m) = REGIME_STABLE and all segment medians > 0; COST_ROBUST = edge(1.0) and edge(2.0); COST_RESILIENT_BASE_ONLY = edge(1.0) and not edge(2.0); COST_FRAGILE = edge(0.0) and not edge(1.0); NO_PRE_COST_EDGE = not edge(0.0)): lookback 3 COST_ROBUST=6 (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META, TSLA) / NO_PRE_COST_EDGE=4; lookback 5 COST_ROBUST=5 (AAPL, GOOGL, AMZN, META, TSLA) / COST_FRAGILE=1 (MSFT) / NO_PRE_COST_EDGE=4 (NVDA, JPM, JNJ, XOM); lookback 10 COST_ROBUST=5 (MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META, TSLA) / NO_PRE_COST_EDGE=5; overall 16/30 COST_ROBUST, 13 NO_PRE_COST_EDGE, 1 COST_FRAGILE. Lookback 5 at 1.0x: median candidate +0.069, median null -0.008. A-priori prediction (COST_ROBUST <= 3/10 at lookback 5) falsified. Independent verifier: all gates MATCH (fresh AMZN/JPM recomputation at every lookback/cost; 0.0x cross-consistency 30/30; classification 30/30); 168/168 regression tests pass. Durable negative/methodological finding: the existing engine's slippage is added to the fill price on both buys and sells, so candidate medians are invariant to the cost multiplier (AAPL +0.070 at 0x/2x; MSFT +0.062; AMZN +0.076; TSLA +0.107) and the matched null is unstable at positive costs (NVDA fold log return -27.631 at 0.5x; median null +0.396 at 1.0x). The COST_ROBUST label is therefore conditional on the existing cost model, not evidence that the momentum edge survives a valid conservative cost stress.
